subject: general
question: A lie detector apparatus is also known as a:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Polygraph**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **polygraph test** is popularly known as a **lie detector test**, it is a machine that measures a person’s physiological responses when they respond to questions.
 
• Polygraph tests measure a person’s **heart rate or blood pressure**, **respiration**, and **skin conductivity**.
 
• The purpose of the test is usually to prove whether a **person has committed a crime or not**.
 
• These tests cannot actually test for honesty. Instead, it relies on the polygraph operator’s analysis on tested person’s responses, which can be inaccurate.
 
• Polygraphs are not admissible as evidence in United States courts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **seismometer** is an instrument that responds to ground noises and shaking caused by earthquakes, explosions, and volcanic eruptions. They are combined with a timing device and a recording device to form a seismograph.
 
• A **barograph** is a barometer that records barometric pressure over time in graphical form. This instrument is also used to make a continuous recording of atmospheric pressure.
 
• A **polarimeter** is an instrument used to measure the angle of rotation caused by passing polarized light through an optically active substance.
